task_name: Implement the server-side personal rollup and global detail read

concerns_addressed: P1-005 is resolved with a pure reusable resolver in server/src/core/my-work-done-target.ts. Board resolution delegates to mapColumnSlots and resolveColumnForStatusChange over workspace-and-board-scoped columns, then resolves the required kind=status slot=done vocabulary. Tracker resolution uses the workspace kind=status slot=done vocabulary.

Board done columns and Tracker done vocabularies are loaded in at most one batched query each, with unique workspace IDs and deterministic position/id ordering; no per-row mapping query is introduced.

The mapping loader runs after the authorized candidate set is obtained. Default list/detail source queries retain membership and assignee predicates, and detail performs the existing reauthorization checks before hydration and capability serialization.
List and detail both flow through hydrateMyWorkRows and serializeMyWorkCandidate, so capability fields use the same resolver and response shape.

Capability precedence is exact: normalized completed/canceled status returns false/terminal before mapping lookup; nonterminal candidates return false/missing_done_mapping when no valid target exists and true/null when a target resolves. No server pending state is invented.

The correction changes only the five T2-attributed server resolver, hydration, serialization, and test files. It adds no T3 mutation, T8 UI, client mapping guess, schema/SSE/navigation/OAuth change, or log/review mutation beyond this T2 artifact.

strengths: The canonical resolver is side-effect-free and reuses the existing Board resolver rather than reproducing column-slot rules. It scopes sibling columns by workspace and board, and selects Tracker status targets deterministically by position then id.

Hydration deduplicates workspace IDs and performs one columns query plus one done-vocabulary query per candidate set, while existing assignee/label hydration remains set-based. The actual Kysely Postgres seam test observes exactly two mapping queries across multiple workspaces and 24 rows.

Terminal filtering is performed before mapping hydration, and serialization checks terminal precedence before resolving a target. Existing auth, assignment, soft-delete, deduplication, source boundaries, and error behavior are untouched by the correction.
List/detail parity is exercised through the same default service hydration path, including current authorized detail rechecks and matching canMarkDone/markDoneReason output.

Tests cover valid and missing Board column/status mappings, Board isolation across boards, valid/missing and multiple deterministic Tracker targets, workspace isolation, terminal precedence without pending, list/detail parity, multiple workspaces, and bounded query count.

Independent verification passed: targeted resolver/capability tests (10/10), full server tests (844 passed, 273 skipped), full repository tests (844 server passed/273 skipped and 971 client passed), server and client typechecks, root Biome lint, mutation-routing check, and git diff --check.
